description: Allow the remote liveview UI (loaded over the tailnet from liveview.hawk.thundersparrow.top) to invoke native OS haptics. The remote origin needs its OWN core:default for the IPC layer to function at all (a remote capability is independent of the local loader's default capability), plus the explicit haptics allow-* permissions — there is NO haptics:default identifier. All four haptic commands are granted so future web call sites (impact / notification / selection / vibrate) work with no native rebuild. iOS Safari/PWA has no reliable web haptic, so this native path is the only one that buzzes.
